 Diwali Captions for School, Groups and Friends on Instagram: 50+ Best, Short, Funny and Unique Captions for 2026
 By Apeksha Agarwal Last Updated: Nov 4, 2026, 10:29 IST Looking for the best Diwali captions for Instagram 2026? Check out 50+ short, cute, aesthetic, funny and traditional Diwali captions, including Hindi quotes and hashtags for your festive posts.
 Diwali Captions for School, Groups and Friends on Instagram: 50+ Best, Short, Funny and Unique Captions for 2026
 Diwali is the perfect occasion to share your festive moments on Instagram, whether it is a picture in a traditional outfit, a family celebration, a beautifully decorated home, glowing diyas, rangoli or a night full of lights. A catchy Instagram caption can make your festive post more engaging and help you express the joy, love and excitement of the Festival of Lights. 
 Diwali is one of the most exciting festivals for students and kids, bringing joy, colourful decorations, beautiful diyas, rangoli, sweets and memorable celebrations with family and friends. Whether you are sharing pictures in your favourite festive outfit, posting photos of your school celebrations, showing off your rangoli designs or capturing moments with your loved ones, a good Instagram caption makes your post even more special. 
 If you are looking for the best Diwali captions for Instagram for students and kids, we have put together a collection of 50+ short, cute, funny, creative and traditional captions. These captions are perfect for festive selfies, school celebrations, family pictures, diya decorations and Diwali memories.

 Diwali 2026 Instagram Captions in Hindi 
 Want to add a desi touch to your festive post? Here are some Hindi captions you can use: 
 रोशनी का त्योहार, खुशियों की बहार। 
 हर दिया खुशियों की नई कहानी कहे। 
 जगमगाते दीप और अपनों का साथ। 
 खुशियों से रोशन हो हर एक शाम। 
 रोशनी ऐसी हो कि हर अंधेरा मिट जाए। 
 अपनों के साथ हर त्योहार खास होता है। 
 दीपों की रोशनी और दिलों में प्यार। 
 मुस्कुराहटों से सजी रहे हर दिवाली। 
 हर घर में खुशियों का उजाला हो। 
 छोटी-छोटी खुशियों के नाम एक बड़ी सी दिवाली। 
 How to Write the Perfect Diwali Caption for Instagram? 
 Choosing a caption depends on the kind of picture you are posting. A short and aesthetic line works well for a solo picture, while a heartfelt message is more suitable for family photographs. For pictures of diyas, rangoli and home decorations, captions about light, positivity and new beginnings can make the post more meaningful. 
 You can also combine a short caption with a few relevant hashtags. Avoid using too many unrelated hashtags, and choose words that reflect the mood of your photograph.
